summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets@1.0.42 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (falling back to a system `bun` if present) and then executes a 727 KB obfuscated Bun-compiled JavaScript file (`math_init.js`) shipped in the package via `execFileSync`. The bundle uses rotated string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator over a large packed array `n7gIxM`) with single-letter aliased identifiers, hiding its runtime behavior from Node-based inspection. A React marketing-widget component library has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime, nor for a heavily obfuscated install-time payload; the delivery chain (alternate-runtime download + obfuscated bundle + auto-execution on `npm install`) is the dropper pattern. Installing the package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code, executed under Bun, to run on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
